metadata.hardware_requirements: computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)

nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic volume data and driving behavior parameters from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao through a tunnel in Shandong, China, used for simulation calibration.
nodes_source.size_estimate: 10-min traffic volumes from 7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The paper explicitly states in the 'Data Availability' section that the data is available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations from raw images are extracted to reconstruct visual representations in the DRL method
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle coordinates (xi, yi) from raw frames and maps them to position matrices. Encodes current signal state into the matrix. Stacks N=3 consecutive frames to capture vehicle dynamics, resulting in a state matrix of dimension (3, 4, 512).
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, dimensions and stacking logic fully specified; no concrete extraction tools named.

nodes_process.source_quote: The algorithm for training the ramp metering policy is presented in Algorithm 1.
nodes_process.description: Trains a Q-network using multitask learning to estimate Q-values and predict mean speed and queue length simultaneously. Employs experience replay and a target network to stabilize training. Uses the Adam optimizer and epsilon-greedy exploration strategy.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all hyperparameters in Table 1, specific optimizer and hardware named.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator
nodes_process.description: Runs 20 simulation experiments on a modeled freeway network. Compares the trained DRL model against No-control and PI-ALINEA baselines. Measures travel time, queue length, speed, and downstream flow.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, baseline parameters and simulation settings fully specified; SUMO version missing.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Divides the control area into 8 subareas. Systematically removes information from each subarea from the input data to measure its relative impact on the control performance (travel time).
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, procedure described but specific removal mechanism for 'information' is terse.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 8: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Line graphs showing the evolution of episode rewards and mean travel times over one million training frames for the DRL agent.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Training parameters are specified, but exact traffic data files and random seeds for simulation runs are not provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Time-series plot comparing mainline travel time distributions (quartiles) for No control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Procedure using SUMO simulator is well-described; input data is real-world but not directly provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2 presents mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_sink.description: A table comparing mean travel times and percentage reductions relative to no control for 20 simulation runs using PI-ALINEA and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Numerical results are explicitly stated and align with stated methodology, though raw traffic data is only available on request.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10 presents the temporal-spatial distribution of the mean speeds along the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Spatiotemporal heatmaps showing vehicle speeds across freeway distance and time for three control scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Visual representation of simulation data; underlying raw data points for the heatmaps are not provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11 presents the Q1, Q2, and Q3 of the queue lengths at the on-ramp in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Time-series distribution of vehicle queue lengths at the on-ramp comparing different control methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulation environment and metrics are standard; results follow logically from described DRL agent behavior.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12: Relationship of queue length and red ratio for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Scatter plots showing the correlation between mean queue lengths and the proportion of red signal phases in simulation runs.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Correlation results depend on simulation outputs which are not publicly released.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13: Queue length and occupancy for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Plots correlating on-ramp queue length with downstream occupancy, showing higher correlation for the baseline method than for DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Method for calculating correlation and occupancy is clear; outcomes support claims about DRL information utilization.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 14: Downstream volume in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Box plots showing traffic volume downstream of the merging area at 5-minute intervals for three control scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Statistical distribution of flow results from SUMO; dependent on specific traffic demand data provided as input.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 16: Travel time with perturbed input data.
nodes_sink.description: Box plots showing the sensitivity of travel time results when visual information from different subareas is removed.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Ablation study procedure is well-defined and identifies which subareas are most critical for model performance.
